description: Reopen r-sort-3b-nulls (General) read-only. Reads the IDs held by each of the 15 tables (ORDER BY ID) and every table's index metadata (Name, Primary, Unique, Foreign, Required, IgnoreNulls, DistinctCount, field names and attributes). Asks which inserts each Null option refused or admitted (unique with IGNORE NULL, with DISALLOW NULL, plain; before and after the rows), and what the engine reports for the options.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
